title: System Explorer status roll-up
description: Per-collection severity roll-up for one host (ROADMAP slice 1): the worst row level and level counts for every collection the host exposes, so a degraded object is visible without knowing which collection to open. The roll-up is nullable by design — a collection may decline with a reason (a bounded log query has no current health) or fail with an error, degrading the envelope to partial rather than failing it. Shared $defs are duplicated from observation.schema.json deliberately so each schema file is standalone.

status.description: partial when at least one collection's acquisition failed; errors lists each failure. Never error — a failed collection degrades one entry, not the envelope (SPEC section 2, rule 7).

subsystems.description: Subsystem name -> collection name -> roll-up entry.

worst.description: critical > warn > ok when any row is positively healthy > info when rows exist but none is vouched for > null for an empty collection.

counts.description: Rows per worst_opinion_level; only nonzero levels appear. none counts rows that carry no severity field.

reason.description: Why this collection has no roll-up: declined by design (no health semantics) or unavailable per capability discovery. Not a failure.

error.description: The acquisition failure; mirrored in the top-level errors, which sets status partial.
